app.name: Modern Clipboard History
app.description: A Windows 11-style clipboard history manager for Linux

clipboard.title: Clipboard History
clipboard.empty_state_desc: Copy some text or an image to see it here.
clipboard.empty_hint: Then press Super+V anytime to paste from history.
clipboard.clear_confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all history?

settings_page.title: Settings
settings_page.personalization_desc: Customize the look, language, and privacy of your clipboard history

features.label: Features
features.smart_actions_desc: Detect URLs, emails, colors in text
features.dynamic_tray_desc: Auto-change icon based on system theme

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.fix_desc: Check and fix input permissions for keystroke simulation

privacy.label: Privacy & security
privacy.desc: Clipboard history stays on this machine. Tune what is stored.
privacy.filter_secrets_desc: Do not save private keys, API tokens, JWTs, or password= values.
privacy.save_images_desc: Store copied images as files on disk (thumbnails only in the UI).
privacy.exclude_apps_desc: On X11, skip capture from KeePass, 1Password, Bitwarden, and private browsing windows.
privacy.wm_rewrite_desc: Off by default. When enabled, setup may comment out existing Super+V bindings in i3/Sway/Hyprland.
privacy.storage_note: History is stored locally at ~/.local/share/win11-clipboard-history/ (mode 0600). Text fields are encrypted at rest (ChaCha20-Poly1305); the key lives in history.key or the Secret Service keyring. Nothing is uploaded unless you search GIFs with TENOR_API_KEY set.
privacy.wayland_note: Wayland does not expose the focused window. Password-manager skipping works on X11 only; keep Skip secrets enabled.
privacy.key_storage_desc: History is encrypted at rest. Choose where the key lives.
privacy.key_backend_file_desc: Key file next to the database, mode 0600. Works everywhere, no extra dependencies.
privacy.key_backend_secret_desc: GNOME Keyring / KWallet via Secret Service. The key never touches the disk.
privacy.key_unavailable: secret-tool not found — install libsecret-tools to use the keyring.
privacy.key_restart_note: The new backend takes effect on the next launch.

setup.welcome_desc: A modern, beautiful clipboard history manager for Linux
setup.step_permissions_desc: Check access to virtual keyboard simulation
setup.step_shortcut_desc: Set up a shortcut to quickly show clipboard history
